gsap_non_transform_motion: GSAP tween on ".head" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
